name: pdfPageCount
description: Returns the number of pages in a PDF document.

params.name: pdfObj
params.description: A PDF object from pdfRead() or pdf().

examples.title: Get the page count
examples.description: Count the pages in a PDF.
examples.code:
doc = PdfRead( expandPath( "/invoice.pdf" ) );
writeOutput( PdfPageCount( doc ) );
